description: This file contains a test case for verifying the functionality of the 'team_config' feature in the 'litellm' module. It sets up a team configuration, loads it via the ProxyConfig class, and performs a completion request using the configured team settings.

classes.name: ProxyConfig
classes.description: A class responsible for managing proxy server configurations, including loading team-specific configurations.

methods.name: load_team_config
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the team configuration for a given team ID.

methods.name: completion
methods.description: Generates a language model completion based on provided data and team configuration.
